visibleStructure.observation: The window opens on Ferris in the blue-curtained bedroom; the visible previous line tells the patient to stay quiet until recovered. Subaru then enters in a light robe. This is a late window and does not supply the whole episode.
Subaru speech panel reads 「……そうだな。わかったよ」 (two display lines), followed by the character/panel departure and the bedroom blur/dark transition.

visibleStructure.event: White opening, closing doors, dim tail
visibleStructure.observation: A white field gives way to two brown paneled doors with rounded central inset motifs, flared bluish-white seam light and colored edge fringe. The doors close while the view recedes; the light narrows to a thin vertical/horizontal cross, then the closed doorway darkens to an almost-black tail.
The book-page/silver-haired-portrait collage becomes visible and carries 「IFルート：クルシュ」 above 「CLEAR」. This is a visibly illustrated ending card, not a plain black title background.

After the ending-card fade there is a dark loading/Connecting interval, then a flowchart. A green observed line runs through the Ferris thumbnail node (「……生きてる？」) to Complete 「クルシュ邸にて」 and down to END 「IFルート：クルシュ」. The visible upstream green choice heading is 「助けを願った」.
The flowchart is covered by 「ルートクリア報酬を受け取りました」, 「本編 第8話」 and a ×50 gem reward/OK popup. The bounded window stops with that popup; it does not show a later new episode starting.

observedImagesThatMustNotBeMisclassified: The silver-haired portrait/book-page collage is the ending-card backdrop.
The Ferris image in the final flowchart is a node thumbnail, not a newly played CG in this ending window.
